engagement.rules_of_engagement: HARD CONSTRAINTS: (1) No destructive testing - no data deletion, no DoS/high-volume flooding, no availability degradation for real users. (2) No action that could cost real money - do NOT complete/trigger any real Whish transaction, do NOT submit real payment data, no charges/refunds/financial state changes; payment flow testing limited to logic/validation/access-control (IDOR on order/payment refs, price/amount tampering in requests, auth bypass around checkout steps, session handling) via safe/observational methods only, stopping before any step that finalizes a real charge. (3) Stay within zakerne.com and actual subdomains only. (4) Owner has another team already monitoring site security - pace scans professionally/moderately, avoid loud high-volume scanning that could be mistaken for a real attack. Scope checklist: OWASP Top 10 web app logic, auth/session mgmt, payment/checkout config (logic only), API endpoints, admin/backend access controls, misconfigs/exposed secrets, known-CVE/outdated dependency checks.
